args.stdin:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT readfile('/uploads/receipt_ocr_e8UA6EEy.txt') AS content
),
lines AS (
  SELECT trim(value) AS line
  FROM raw, json_each('["' || replace(content, char(10), '","') || '"]')
  WHERE line != ''
),
words AS (
  SELECT
    line,
    substr(line, 1, instr(line || ' ', ' ') - 1) AS word1,
    substr(line, instr(line || ' ', ' ') + 1) AS rest
  FROM lines
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    line,
    substr(rest, 1, instr(rest || ' ', ' ') - 1),
    substr(rest, instr(rest || ' ', ' ') + 1)
  FROM words
  WHERE rest != ''
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT
    line,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN word END) AS sku,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN CAST(word AS INTEGER) END) AS qty,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN CAST(REPLACE(word, ',', '.') AS REAL) * 100 END) AS unit_price_cents
  FROM (
    SELECT line, word, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY line) AS rn
    FROM words
  )
  GROUP BY line
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
),
old_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(qty * unit_price_cents) AS old_total_cents FROM parsed
),
current_prices AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.price_cents
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN parsed ON pv.product_sku = parsed.sku
),
current_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(cp.price_cents * p.qty) AS current_total_cents
  FROM current_prices cp
  JOIN parsed p ON cp.product_sku = p.sku
)
SELECT
  old_total_cents,
  current_total_cents,
  ABS(old_total_cents - current_total_cents) AS abs_diff_cents
FROM old_total, current_total;

within.message: The total price difference is {abs_diff_cents} cents, which is within the 2 EUR threshold.

exceeds.message: The total price difference is {abs_diff_cents} cents, which is exceeds the 2 EUR threshold.
